_doc: Champion exceptions for ult tracking. Edit freely; no code changes needed. Names are Data Dragon ids (MonkeyKing = Wukong).

skip_cooldown_filter: ults with recasts, charges/ammo, transforms, resets or stolen ults, where 'pressed again before the cooldown is over' is normal. Live presses for these are never filtered for cooldown.
usable_while_dead: ults that can be cast while dead.
cooldown_delay: seconds from the key press until the ability bar shows the ult on cooldown (cast times, channels, recasts). Default: default_cooldown_delay.

cooldown_filter_game_modes: game modes (Live Client Data API gameMode) where the normal cooldown math applies. Modes with global haste or different rules (URF, Arena, Practice Tool with its No Cooldowns option...) aren't listed: the cooldown filter is off there and the recording decides.

kinds (v1.6): what one ult is. command = the first R summons something, later R presses command it until it's gone; multi_cast = one ult with several activations / an early end / a second part; transform = every press is a real cast with a short cooldown (shown as 'Form swap'); charges_or_reset = every press is a real cast (ammo, charges, resets); champions not listed are normal. ends: what ends an episode (cooldown = the ult's long cooldown appears, icon = the R icon returns to its ready look, duration = the longest duration in seconds per rank, always applied). grace: seconds after the ending cooldown that still count as recasts (Sylas: the stolen ult's own recasts). ammo: casts with charges left show no cooldown on the icon. cast_delay: press -> first change on the R icon. Checked against Data Dragon 16.19.1 (cargo run -p cv-game-league --example ultscan) and the League wiki; re-run the scan each patch. A champion not listed whose R text looks like a recast is treated as multi_cast.
